news.title: Polymarket traders cut Clarity Act passage odds to record low as Senate delay drags on
news.summary: Polymarket bettors have cut the odds of the CLARITY Act passing this year to a record low as Senate negotiations over ethics provisions remain unresolved.

news.summary: Crypto and blockchain experts say this week's moves show the two established finance companies are increasingly competing for control of the infrastructure behind digital payments.
